/about.title: 1 About/
copy: GOPHER AI is a paid phone assistant. $19/month. FETCH is search (ticker, fear/greed, ask GOPHER). DIG is do a task from the 100 (watch, remind, draft, nav). Waitlist is the door. Checkout parked.
The name is the point. Old Gopher was a menu, a selector, a fetch. No infinite scroll. No chat sludge. A modern prompt sits on that contract.
MAZE and BURROW are a side quest — kill time between searches. They are not the product.

/play.title: How to play MAZE/
/play.copy: MAZE is a 100-stage side quest on this site. Kill time between searches. Alternate pathways. One tap, one tile — you never auto-run. Wall −0.1 HP, star ZAP/BLOCK, KEY, trophy, Eternal GOPHER CHAMPIONS. Free demo. Not the paid phone assistant. BURROW is a separate 30-stage burrow (type burrow or Play/). FETCH is search. DIG is a task.
/play.copy_es: MAZE es un side quest de 100 etapas en este sitio. Mata el tiempo entre búsquedas. Caminos alternos. Un toque, un tile — nunca corre solo. Muro −0.1 HP, estrella ZAP/BLOCK, KEY, trofeo, Eternal GOPHER CHAMPIONS. Demo gratis. No es el asistente de teléfono de pago. BURROW es una madriguera aparte de 30 etapas (escribe burrow o Play/). FETCH es search. DIG es una tarea.
steps: Open Play/, type maze, or open #/fetch.
Hit START.
Move one tile at a time — arrows, WASD, or the pad. You never auto-run.
Eat energy pellets. They shout Huzaaa!
Walls bump: Clunk!!! costs 0.1 HP. Health bar starts at 3.0.
Orange foxes hit: Ouchies! costs 1 HP.
One star per stage. Pick it up, then ZAP a fox or BLOCK a hit.
KEY or K shows the in-game key.
Clear a stage: VICTORY! Clock hits 0: TIME OVER!
Foxes speed up 0.01 each stage. Time limit is reasonable. Stage 100 is nearly impossible.
Clear all 100: GOPHER CHAMPION!, a trophy, and your name on Eternal GOPHER CHAMPIONS.
Device best on this device. Global board and Eternal GOPHER CHAMPIONS are python /api/scores and /api/champions only — Pages has no python.
Friendly chiptune + FX. MUTE defaults on (browser autoplay).
Press 9 to login on this device.
steps_es: Abre Play/, escribe maze, o abre #/fetch.
Pulsa START.
Muévete un tile a la vez — flechas, WASD, o el pad. Nunca corre solo.
Come pellets de energía. Gritan Huzaaa!
Choque con muro: Clunk!!! cuesta 0.1 HP. La barra de vida empieza en 3.0.
Golpe de zorro naranja: Ouchies! cuesta 1 HP.
Una estrella por etapa. Recógela, luego ZAP a un zorro o BLOCK un golpe.
KEY o K muestra la clave del juego.
Limpia una etapa: VICTORY! El reloj llega a 0: TIME OVER!
Los zorros aceleran 0.01 cada etapa. El límite de tiempo es razonable. La etapa 100 es casi imposible.
Limpia las 100: GOPHER CHAMPION!, un trofeo, y tu nombre en Eternal GOPHER CHAMPIONS.
Mejor del dispositivo en este dispositivo. La tabla global y Eternal GOPHER CHAMPIONS son python /api/scores y /api/champions nada más — Pages no tiene python.
Chiptune amable + FX. MUTE por defecto (autoplay del navegador).
Pulsa 9 para login en este dispositivo.
/play.note: Type howto in the prompt. Play/ for MAZE and BURROW. Side quest — kill time between searches.
/play.note_es: Escribe howto en el prompt. Play/ para MAZE y BURROW. Side quest — mata el tiempo entre búsquedas.

/faq.title: FAQ/
copy: What is GOPHER AI? A paid phone assistant named after the 1991 Gopher protocol. FETCH is search. DIG is do a task from the 100. This site is the public hole, not the number yet. Waitlist is the door.
How do I play the side quest? Open Play/ or type maze. MAZE is a 100-stage maze (#/fetch). BURROW is an 30-stage burrow (#/dig). One tap, one tile. Kill time between searches. Not the product.
Is login cloud? No. A name and passphrase hashed with PBKDF2 in localStorage on this device. Not a GOPHER AI account.
Is FETCH live prices? FETCH is search. Type fetch btc (or ETH, SOL, XRP, fear greed) in the prompt. No invented prices. The maze is MAZE, a side quest.

GitHub Pages vs local? Pages is a static hole (directory, FETCH, DIG, device login, client waitlist). There is no python process on Pages, so no true global board or global champions list. python3 server.py on your machine adds /health (process liveness), /api/waitlist, /api/score, /api/scores, /api/champions, /api/ask. Device best and a local eternal list still work on Pages. No fake 99.9%.
How do I waitlist? Waitlist in the top bar, type waitlist, or use the email form on #/waitlist. On Pages it stores on this device if the API is missing. Local python keeps the server list.
What does it cost? $19/month. Waitlist is the door. Checkout is not live yet. MAZE stays free.

¿El login es nube? No. Un nombre y una frase secreta hasheados con PBKDF2 en localStorage en este dispositivo. No es una cuenta GOPHER AI.
¿FETCH es precios en vivo? FETCH es search. Escribe fetch btc (o ETH, SOL, XRP, fear greed) en el prompt. Sin precios inventados. El laberinto es MAZE, un side quest.

¿GitHub Pages vs local? Pages es un hueco estático (directorio, FETCH, DIG, login del dispositivo, lista de espera del cliente). No hay proceso python en Pages, así que no hay tabla global de verdad ni lista global de campeones. python3 server.py en tu máquina añade /health (vida del proceso), /api/waitlist, /api/score, /api/scores, /api/champions, /api/ask. El mejor del dispositivo y una lista eterna local sí funcionan en Pages. Sin 99.9% inventado.

¿Cómo entro a la lista de espera? Waitlist en la barra, escribe waitlist, o usa el formulario de email en #/waitlist. En Pages se guarda en este dispositivo si falta la API. El python local guarda la lista del servidor.

/security.title: Security/
copy: Login is PBKDF2 (SHA-256, 120000 iterations) in localStorage. Not cloud. The passphrase never leaves this device.
No API keys in the page. No wallet keys. No phone number stored here.

FETCH scores post only to local /api/score when you run python3 server.py. That is the server-wide board (GET /api/scores). Eternal GOPHER CHAMPIONS post to /api/champions on that same server. GitHub Pages has no python process and no score API. Device best still works.
Waitlist email goes to /api/waitlist locally, or stays in this browser on Pages.
watch / remind / draft stay on this device. Not SMS.

No hay API keys en la página. No hay claves de wallet. No hay número de teléfono guardado aquí.

Los puntajes FETCH se postean solo a /api/score local cuando corres python3 server.py. Esa es la tabla del servidor (GET /api/scores). Eternal GOPHER CHAMPIONS se postea a /api/champions en ese mismo servidor. GitHub Pages no tiene proceso python ni API de puntajes. El mejor del dispositivo sí funciona.
El email de lista de espera va a /api/waitlist en local, o se queda en este navegador en Pages.
watch / remind / draft se quedan en este dispositivo. No SMS.
